settings.hero_subheadline: A simple system that helps you get out of bed, reduce morning rush, and start your day with control.

settings.headline: Design over discipline
settings.subheadline: MOOV combines a wall-mounted device and mobile app to make getting up easier than staying in bed.

settings.title: Place MOOV device on the wall in your desired location (max 30 ft)
settings.body: 10-second, damage-free install with 3M tape. We recommend placing it where you usually go first.
settings.explain_body: Distance creates intention. When you have to move to silence the alarm, your body wakes before your mind can negotiate a snooze.

settings.title: Set your desired get-up time in the MOOV app
settings.body: Choose your alarm sound and volume. Set a pre-alert for 1-2 minutes before your main alarm so you wake lightly before needing to get up.
settings.explain_body: Pre-alert and sound controls help reduce sleep shock, so your wake-up feels smoother and easier to follow through on.

settings.title: When the alarm rings, you get up to turn it off
settings.body: The phone plays the alarm. You must interact with the MOOV device to silence it.
settings.explain_body: The alarm ends only after action, reinforcing a repeatable morning habit that favors getting up over staying in bed.

settings.heading: Ready to try it out?
settings.subheading: Normal alarms wake you up. MOOV gets you up. Start tomorrow with less rush and more control.

settings.question: How is MOOV different from a normal alarm?
settings.answer: MOOV does not just wake you up. It gets you up. A normal alarm goes off beside your bed, where it is easy to hit snooze half-asleep. MOOV changes that by making you physically get out of bed and walk to your device to turn it off.

settings.question: Can’t I just put my phone across the room instead?
settings.answer: You can, but most people do not stick with it. MOOV is designed to make getting up automatic, not dependent on willpower.

settings.question: What if I just get up, turn it off, and go back to bed?
settings.answer: That is possible, but MOOV makes it far less likely. That first bit of movement is often the hardest part, and MOOV helps you get past it.

settings.question: Does MOOV make the alarm sound?
settings.answer: No. Your phone plays the alarm sound. MOOV works with the app and the wall-mounted device.

settings.question: How does the device work?
settings.answer: Set your alarm in the app, mount MOOV away from your bed, and when the alarm sounds, get up and press the device to stop it.
